profile_text.body:
Pitch is a collaborative presentation platform for teams, according to its website. The company says the product is built for creating, sharing, and delivering presentations together, with shared templates and a brand library intended to keep teams consistent when they are producing work at scale. It describes its AI as adapting to a team's workflow, and says users can start from a blank canvas, a template, or AI-generated on-brand slides, while retaining design control over the details.

Pitch AI is the company's tracked AI product, described as presentation software with collaboration, template generation, and EU-hosted hosting. The site says users can choose from 150+ fully customizable templates or import an existing PPTX file. No litigation, regulatory filings, or other third-party records are held for the company.
